_meta.purpose: Recommended, sourced default data for the Ampy laddbox/EV savings calculator. Shaped like the engine data (window.AmpyEvCalcData). Pairs with DATA-DOSSIER.md. Maps to excel/laddbox-kalkylator-data.xlsx via the schema in excel/EXCEL-SCHEMA.md.

conventions.efficiencyKwhPer10km: WLTP basis. Engine applies a SEPARATE 10% charging loss (chargerEfficiencyPct 0.90, energy/0.90). Do NOT inflate per-model figures for winter/charging or losses double-count.
conventions.homeRateSekPerKwh: All-in MARGINAL kr/kWh incl. 25% moms (spot+rorlig elnat+energiskatt+paslag). Excludes fixed monthly fees.
conventions.gronTeknik: rate is a FRACTION (0.485 = 48.5%); cap is SEK per applicant.
conventions._source_flags: AMPY_MUST_PROVIDE = placeholder, do not publish without Ampy sign-off. RESEARCHED = sourced in DATA-DOSSIER.md.

chargerEfficiencyPct._note: Fraction. 10% charging loss applied as energy/0.90. Per-model figures must stay WLTP so this is not double-counted.

gronTeknikRate._note: Fraction. 48.5% = statutory laddningspunkt skattereduktion rate. CONFIRM with Ampy / Skatteverket before publishing.

gronTeknikCapPerApplicant._note: SEK per applicant per year (statutory Grön Teknik cap). CONFIRM with Ampy.

maxApplicants._note: Two co-owners -> effective household cap 100000 kr. CONFIRM with Ampy.

uncertaintyBand._note: Fraction (+/-10%). Supports legal requirement to present the saving as a RANGE, not a fixed figure.

RATES._gronTeknikEligibilityWording: Grön teknik-avdraget ger 48,5 % skattereduktion på arbets- och materialkostnad för installation av en laddningspunkt till elfordon. Avdraget dras direkt på fakturan. Taket är 50 000 kr per person och år och kan delas av upp till två personer som äger bostaden. Förutsätter tillräcklig skatt att reducera. (AMPY_MUST_PROVIDE — confirm wording vs Skatteverket.)

ADVANCED_DEFAULTS._note: publicChargingPct is the 0-100 UI slider value (NOT a fraction). publicChargingType pairs with the DC rate.
